questions.question: Which metal is liquid at room temperature?
questions.note: Mercury is the only metallic element that is liquid at standard conditions; gallium and caesium melt just above room temperature.

questions.question: Which is the most abundant metal in the Earth's crust?
questions.note: Aluminium makes up about 8% of the Earth's crust, more than any other metal.

questions.question: Which metal has the highest electrical conductivity of all metals?
questions.note: Silver beats copper, which is the more common (and cheaper) conductor in wires.

questions.question: Bronze is traditionally an alloy of copper and which metal?
questions.note: Modern bronze is typically about 88% copper and 12% tin.

questions.question: Brass is an alloy of copper and which metal?
questions.note: The copper-to-zinc ratio is varied to get different colours and properties.

questions.question: When zinc reacts with dilute sulfuric acid, which gas is released?
questions.note: The acid strips zinc's protective layer and the reaction releases hydrogen gas.
